name: Sketch-based Cloud Volume Retrieval via SVD
definition: A method to retrieve realistic cloud volumes from a database by matching a user-sketched 2D shape to pre-simulated 3D cloud volumes using SVD basis vectors for efficient similarity calculation.
summary: Sketch-based Cloud Volume Retrieval via SVD retrieves 3D cloud volumes by matching user sketches to a database using Singular Value Decomposition, reducing computational cost by projecting data into a low-dimensional subspace.
